content.Title: 2020 ACC/AHA Guideline for the Management of Valvular Heart Disease
content.Focus: Management and intervention strategies for valvular heart disease, particularly in the context of prosthetic valve endocarditis and associated complications.
Key Topics: Non-regional use of Valsalva in bicuspid aortic valve disease
In-hospital mortality among patients undergoing early surgery for prosthetic valve endocarditis
Systemic infection-related endocarditis on pacemaker leads
Surgical therapy in patients with active infective endocarditis
Antibiotic approaches to prosthetic valve endocarditis
Clinical Findings: Association between early surgery and improved outcomes in left-sided native valve infective endocarditis.
Fungal prosthetic valve endocarditis is rare but associated with high mortality.
Methicillin-resistant vs. methicillin-sensitive Staphylococcus aureus endocarditis outcomes vary considerably.
